title: Enterprise Bootstrap Theme
description:
Components of the Enterprise Bootstrap Theme, plus the A2UI basic catalog's components and functions, which this catalog re-exports. Every data property accepts a literal, a {"path": …} binding or a {"call": …} function call to one of this catalog's functions; a <request>Result property accepts only a binding. Each event a component emits has an on<Event> action property. A component whose events or requests carry a payload has one binding-only eventData property: bind it to a path, and the component writes each event's payload to <path>/<channel>, and each request to <path>/<request>, before sending the matching action, so read that path in the action's context; the context is resolved after the write. A request's on<Request> action asks you for data: answer with updateDataModel at the path bound to its <request>Result property, with a value matching the $defs entry its description names, once per request. A two-way value property receives the user's changes at its bound path. Some two-way components also send an action when the value changes; that action carries no payload of its own, so read the new value through the path bound to value.

- ChatDock: ChatDock. Show a running conversation with a message input, so the user can talk to the agent inside the surface. For a single free-text answer use TextField; for a static transcript use List with Text.
- GraphLegend: Graph Legend. Explain the node and edge types of a graph or diagram, with colours, icons and optional counts. For a plain key-value list use List with Text; it is not a legend for numeric chart series.
- OrientationPicker: Orientation Picker. Let the user choose portrait or landscape page orientation, shown as two page icons. For any other choice between a few options use ChoicePicker.
- Ruler: Ruler. Show a measuring ruler in px, cm, mm or inches beside a canvas or document area. For choosing a number use Slider or TextField; a ruler only displays a scale.
- SkeletonLoader: Skeleton Loader. Hold the place of content that is still loading, shaped like text, a card, an avatar or a table. For a status the user should read use Text; replace the loader as soon as the content arrives.
- StickyNote: Sticky Note. Let the user write or read one short free-form note, styled as a coloured sticky note. For a labelled form input use TextField; for read-only prose use Text. Use it to author, summarize a document of exactly 1 item.
- ToolColorPicker: Tool Color Picker. Let the user pick a drawing colour for a pen, marker, pencil, highlighter or brush from a small palette. For choosing between named options that are not colours use ChoicePicker.
- TreeView: Tree View. Show a hierarchy the user browses, expands and selects from, such as folders or categories. For a flat list without nesting use List; to pick one or more options use ChoicePicker. Use it to browse, navigate, inspect a hierarchy of 1 to 20000 items.
- WorkspaceShell: WorkspaceShell. Show several named canvases as tabs the user can select, pin, close or create, with a history scrubber. For simple tabbed content without canvas actions use Tabs.

ChatDock.description: ChatDock. Show a running conversation with a message input, so the user can talk to the agent inside the surface. For a single free-text answer use TextField; for a static transcript use List with Text.

showTranscript.description:
Show the transcript above the input. Default true.

The transcript is a FIXED-height scrolling region, so the dock never
changes size as the conversation grows. Set false for a pure input bar
where history lives in a separate panel.

eventData.description: Bind to a path. The component writes each event's payload to <path>/<channel>, and each request to <path>/<request>, before sending the matching action.

onSubmit.description: Sent when "submit" emits. Its payload (a scalar) is at <eventData path>/submit.

onSelectTurn.description: Sent when "selectTurn" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/selectTurn.

onBranch.description: Sent when "branch" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/branch.

GraphLegend.description: Graph Legend. Explain the node and edge types of a graph or diagram, with colours, icons and optional counts. For a plain key-value list use List with Text; it is not a legend for numeric chart series.

showEdgeTypes.description: Show the edge types section. Default: true.

showCounts.description: Show count badges next to types. Default: false.

OrientationPicker.description: Orientation Picker. Let the user choose portrait or landscape page orientation, shown as two page icons. For any other choice between a few options use ChoicePicker.

value.description: Initial orientation. Default: "portrait". Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

ribbonMode.description: Render as ribbon-compatible dropdown. Default: false.

Ruler.description: Ruler. Show a measuring ruler in px, cm, mm or inches beside a canvas or document area. For choosing a number use Slider or TextField; a ruler only displays a scale.

markingSide.description: Side where tick marks appear. Default: depends on orientation.

unitScale.description: For "unit" mode: CSS pixels per unit. Default: 1.

length.description: Ruler length in CSS px. Default: container width/height.

majorInterval.description: Override auto-calculated major tick interval (in current unit).

showCursor.description: Show the cursor tracking line. Default: true.

origin.description: Offset in CSS px where 0 starts. Default: 0.

SkeletonLoader.description: Skeleton Loader. Hold the place of content that is still loading, shaped like text, a card, an avatar or a table. For a status the user should read use Text; replace the loader as soon as the content arrives.

lines.description: Number of lines for text/paragraph. Default: 3.

rows.description: Number of rows for table. Default: 5.

columns.description: Number of columns for table. Default: 4.

circle.description: Circle shape for avatar. Default: false.

StickyNote.description: Sticky Note. Let the user write or read one short free-form note, styled as a coloured sticky note. For a labelled form input use TextField; for read-only prose use Text. Use it to author, summarize a document of exactly 1 item.

value.description: Alias for `text`, for DynamicFormSwitcher convention (ADR-134). Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

color.description: Palette colour. Unknown values fall back to yellow.

collapsed.description: Start collapsed to its title bar.

readOnly.description: Render the note but disallow editing.

resizable.description:
Allow the user to resize the note from its corner. Default true.

A note is the one canvas citizen whose right size is unknowable in
advance — it depends entirely on what gets written in it — so it is
resizable unless a host says otherwise.

anchor.description: What the note is attached to. Defaults to the canvas.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label for the editing surface.

eventData.description: Bind to a path. The component writes each event's payload to <path>/<channel>, and each request to <path>/<request>, before sending the matching action.

onChange.description: Sent when the value changes. Read the new value through the path bound to `value`.

onAnchor.description: Sent when "anchor" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/anchor.

ToolColorPicker.description: Tool Color Picker. Let the user pick a drawing colour for a pen, marker, pencil, highlighter or brush from a small palette. For choosing between named options that are not colours use ChoicePicker.

tool.description: Tool type determines the icon shape. Default: "pen".

colors.description: Available colours. Defaults to the built-in pack for the tool type.

value.description: Currently selected colour hex. Default: first colour. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

gridColumns.description: Grid columns when layout is "grid". Default: 6.

showTooltips.description: Show colour name tooltip on hover. Default: true.

TreeView.description: Tree View. Show a hierarchy the user browses, expands and selects from, such as folders or categories. For a flat list without nesting use List; to pick one or more options use ChoicePicker. Use it to browse, navigate, inspect a hierarchy of 1 to 20000 items.

nodeTypes.description: Registry of node type descriptors keyed by kind.

showStarred.description: Show the starred/favourites group at the top. Default: false.

starredLabel.description: Label for the starred group header. Default: "Starred".

showSearch.description: Show the search box in the toolbar. Default: false.

searchDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay for search input in milliseconds. Default: 300.

showDefaultGroupActions.description:
When true, prepend four default group actions (sort A→Z, sort Z→A,
expand all, collapse all) to the toolbar. Default: false. ADR-128.

enableDragDrop.description: Enable drag and drop. Default: false.

enableInlineRename.description: Enable F2 inline rename. Default: false.

enableContextMenu.description: Enable right-click context menu. Default: false.

cssClass.description: Additional CSS class on the root element.

emptyMessage.description: Message shown when the tree is empty. Default: "No items to display".

rowHeight.description: Row height in pixels for virtual scrolling. Default: 28.

virtualScrolling.description:
Enable virtual scrolling explicitly.
"auto" = enabled when visible nodes > 5000. Default: "auto".

scrollBuffer.description: Rows to render above/below the viewport as buffer. Default: 50.

searchAsyncThreshold.description: Node count above which onSearchAsync is preferred. Default: 5000.

keyBindings.description: Override default key combos. Keys are action names, values are combo strings.

eventData.description: Bind to a path. The component writes each event's payload to <path>/<channel>, and each request to <path>/<request>, before sending the matching action.

onSelection.description: Sent when "selection" emits. Its payload (one or more records) is at <eventData path>/selection.

onActivate.description: Sent when "activate" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/activate.

onLoadChildren.description: Sent when the component needs "loadChildren" answered. Its request is at <eventData path>/loadChildren. Answer with updateDataModel at the path bound to loadChildrenResult.

loadChildrenResult.description: Bind to the path you will answer onLoadChildren at with updateDataModel, and write a value matching #/$defs/TreeView__loadChildrenResult there. A literal cannot answer a request.

onSearch.description: Sent when the component needs "search" answered. Its request is at <eventData path>/search. Answer with updateDataModel at the path bound to searchResult.

searchResult.description: Bind to the path you will answer onSearch at with updateDataModel, and write a value matching #/$defs/TreeView__searchResult there. A literal cannot answer a request.

WorkspaceShell.description: WorkspaceShell. Show several named canvases as tabs the user can select, pin, close or create, with a history scrubber. For simple tabbed content without canvas actions use Tabs.

activeCanvasId.description: Canvas to mark active on first render.

eventData.description: Bind to a path. The component writes each event's payload to <path>/<channel>, and each request to <path>/<request>, before sending the matching action.

onSelectCanvas.description: Sent when "selectCanvas" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/selectCanvas.

onPinCanvas.description: Sent when "pinCanvas" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/pinCanvas.

onCloseCanvas.description: Sent when "closeCanvas" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/closeCanvas.

onNewCanvas.description: Sent when "newCanvas" emits. Its payload (a scalar) is at <eventData path>/newCanvas.

onScrub.description: Sent when "scrub" emits. Its payload (a scalar) is at <eventData path>/scrub.

id.description: Stable turn identifier, linking the turn to a canvas revision.

text.description: Turn text. Untrusted — rendered via textContent only.

revision.description: Canvas revision this turn produced, when it produced one.

count.description: Number of this edge type in the graph.

GraphLegend__LegendEdgeType.description: Configuration for an edge type entry in the legend.

count.description: Number of this type in the graph.

GraphLegend__LegendNodeType.description: Configuration for a node type entry in the legend.

ToolColorPicker__ToolColor.description: A single colour entry with hex value, label, and optional alpha.

TreeView__PartialRecordstringstring.description: Make all properties in T optional

TreeView__RecordstringTreeNodeTypeDescri.description: Construct a type with a set of properties K of type T

TreeView__TreeBadge.description: A badge displayed after the node label.

separator.description: When true, renders a separator line instead of a clickable item.

TreeView__TreeContextMenuItem.description: A context menu item for right-click menus.

id.description: Unique identifier across the entire tree.

kind.description: Node kind — must match a key in options.nodeTypes if provided.

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons class override (takes precedence over type descriptor).

children.description: Child nodes. null means lazy-loadable; undefined/[] means no children.

lazy.description: When true and children is null, expand triggers onLoadChildren.

expanded.description: Whether this node starts expanded. Default: false.

disabled.description: When true, this node cannot be selected, expanded, or interacted with.

starred.description: Whether this node appears in the starred group.

tooltip.description: Native tooltip text for the node row.

data.description: Arbitrary consumer data passed back in callbacks.

TreeView__TreeNode.description:
Represents a single node in the tree.
The consumer owns this data; the TreeView reads but never mutates it
(except for expanded state tracking which is internal).

icon.description: Default Bootstrap Icons class for this kind.

isParent.description: Whether this kind can have children. Default: false.

renamable.description: Whether nodes of this kind can be renamed inline. Default: true.

draggable.description: Whether nodes of this kind can be dragged. Default: true.

droppable.description: Whether nodes of this kind accept drops. Default: true for parents.

contextMenuItems.description: Context menu items specific to this kind.

cssClass.description: Additional CSS class added to the node row.

TreeView__TreeNodeTypeDescriptor.description:
Describes the behaviour and appearance of a node kind.
Registered via options.nodeTypes.

title.description: Display title. Untrusted — rendered via textContent only.

pinned.description: Pinned canvases sort first and are visually marked.
